applicationWindow.notes: Main controlled hunt deadline for deer/elk/pronghorn/sheep/goat. ODFW does not publish a specific cutoff clock time on the synopsis page — apply early on May 15 to avoid the end-of-day rush. Apply via the MyODFW account portal (odfw.huntfishoregon.com) or at any license sales agent. $2 handling fee for in-office changes.

secondaryDraw.notes: Leftover big game tags go on sale Jul 1 at 10:00 AM PT, online only. Point Saver (preference-point-only) application window runs Jul 1 – Nov 30.

nr.notes: 2026 ODFW fee schedule (verified): NR annual hunting license $193, controlled hunt application $10/species, NR elk tag $660. Roosevelt elk available general-season in much of western Oregon (no draw required); Rocky Mountain branched-bull rifle hunts in eastern Oregon are limited-entry (draw only). NR cap is 5% per controlled hunt for deer/elk/bear. Point Saver fee not separately listed on the public fee schedule — equals one application fee in practice.

pointSystem.notes: 75/25 hybrid mechanics on a preference-point base: 75% of tags awarded to first-choice applicants with the most preference points, remaining 25% awarded randomly among all first-choice applicants. One point earned per series (deer/elk/pronghorn/spring bear) per year you don't draw first choice. Bighorn sheep, Rocky Mountain goat, and 'premium' hunts use pure random draw — no preference points apply.

otc.notes: Roosevelt elk (western Oregon) is general-season for most archery and many rifle hunts — effectively OTC for NR, EXCEPT parts of SW Oregon and the Saddle Mountain Unit which are limited-entry. Rocky Mountain elk (eastern Oregon) branched-bull rifle hunts are mostly draw-only; eastern archery and several spike hunts are general-season.

applicationWindow.notes: Shares May 15 controlled hunt deadline. 2026: Oregon Mule Deer Plan implementation — verify your eastern Oregon unit names/boundaries before applying; restructuring is ongoing.

secondaryDraw.notes: Leftover big game tags on sale Jul 1 at 10:00 AM PT, online only.

nr.notes: 2026 NR deer tag $500 (verified). Some general western Oregon deer seasons available OTC. NR cap 5% per controlled hunt.

otc.notes: General western Oregon deer seasons available — verify current units in the 2026 synopsis.

nr.notes: 2026 NR pronghorn tag $443 (verified ODFW fee schedule). NR cap 3% per controlled hunt — tightest cap in the state.
2026 NR bighorn sheep tag $1,695 (verified). Once-in-a-lifetime. Pure random draw — no preference points apply. NR cap 5–10%.

pointSystem.notes: Bighorn sheep and Rocky Mountain goat are random-draw only. No preference points.

nr.notes: 2026 NR Rocky Mountain goat tag $1,695 (verified). Once-in-a-lifetime. Pure random draw — no preference points apply. NR cap 5–10%.

applicationWindow.notes: Spring controlled bear deadline. Leftover spring bear tags on sale Mar 15 at 10:00 AM PT, online only.

nr.notes: ODFW public fee table lists Black Bear tag at $16.50 in the big game line-items (resident figure visible); the NR-specific bear tag price is not on the public synopsis fee table — confirm at MyODFW or with ODFW (503-947-6000) before applying. Fall bear is over-the-counter; spring bear is by controlled draw.

pointSystem.notes: Spring controlled bear uses preference points (75/25 split). Fall bear is OTC — no points needed.

otc.notes: Fall black bear tag is OTC. Spring bear is draw-only.
